ARC-001-DATA-v1.0.title: Data Model: ONS Data Platform Modernisation

controlFields.Distribution: Architecture Board, Data Governance Board, Platform Engineering, Security Team
Project Team, Data Protection Officer, Chief Data Officer, Security Team
controlFields.Author: Enterprise Architect (ArcKit)

controlFields.Gov Analysts: ✅ Synergy: ONS wants data reuse, Analysts want automation
controlFields.App Developers: ✅ Synergy: ONS wants ecosystem growth, Devs build apps
controlFields.Researchers: ✅ Synergy: ONS wants academic citations, Researchers want data
controlFields.GDS/CDDO: ✅ Synergy: Both want Service Standard compliance, GaaP
controlFields.HM Treasury: ⚠️ Tension: ONS wants investment, Treasury controls budget
controlFields.Regulatory Moat: Statistics Act 2007: ONS has statutory monopoly on official UK statistics
controlFields.Data Moat: ONS has exclusive access to Census, survey, admin data (no competitors)
controlFields.Brand Moat: ONS trusted brand (68% public trust, improving to 75%)
controlFields.Standards Moat: First-mover on SDMX-compliant UK statistical APIs (switching costs for users)
controlFields.Ecosystem Moat: 200+ apps built on ONS API create switching costs
controlFields.Cost Moat: Free access (government-funded) → Commercial competitors cannot compete on price
controlFields.6. First API Call: Makes first API call (cURL, Python, R)
controlFields.Community: GitHub Issues, Stack Overflow, Community Forum
controlFields.A1: Government departments will adopt ONS API instead of file downloads
controlFields.A2: Developers can successfully integrate ONS API in <2 days
controlFields.A4: 99.95% SLA is achievable with cloud architecture
controlFields.A5: Free access model drives adoption without revenue concerns from HMT
controlFields.A6: Third-party apps will be built on ONS API (ecosystem growth)
controlFields.A7: Statisticians can operate platform with minimal training
controlFields.A8: SDMX metadata is valuable to users (not just compliance)
controlFields.A10: GDS Service Standard Beta assessment will pass
controlFields.T-007: Build mobile app using ONS data
controlFields.S-004: Chief Data Architect: G-011: Technology Code of Practice (13/13 criteria)
controlFields.Principle 1: Open by Default: Free APIs, Open Government Licence, public access
controlFields.Principle 4: Single Source of Truth: ONS APIs as canonical source, versioned
controlFields.Principle 5: Data Quality: SDMX metadata, quality indicators via API
controlFields.Principle 7: API-First: APIs before web UI, OpenAPI 3.0 specs
controlFields.Principle 10: Security by Design: Zero Trust, API auth, TLS 1.3, audit logs

ARC-001-SECD-v1.0.title: UK Government Secure by Design Assessment

controlFields.Document Type: UK Government Secure by Design Assessment (NCSC CAF)
controlFields.Distribution: Programme Board, SIRO, NCSC, Security Team
controlFields.1. Perimeter: Cloud-native firewalls (Security Groups), DDoS protection (AWS Shield, Azure DDoS Protection)
controlFields.2. Network: Network segmentation (VPC/VNet), IDS/IPS (GuardDuty, Defender), service mesh (mTLS)
controlFields.3. Host: Anti-malware, hardening (CIS benchmarks), patch management (<24 hours critical)
controlFields.4. Application: SAST/DAST in CI/CD, input validation, API rate limiting, WAF
controlFields.5. Data: Encryption at rest (AES-256), encryption in transit (TLS 1.3+), Statistical Disclosure Control
controlFields.6. Identity: MFA, RBAC, PAM, OAuth 2.0, annual access reviews
controlFields.7. Monitoring: SIEM, SOAR, audit logging (7-year retention), pen testing (quarterly/annual)
controlFields.R-012: Cyber security breach of pre-release data
